nodes.name: Act 1 (Ogham)
nodes.summary: First PoE2 act, in the forests of Ogham and Clearfell. The Exile escapes execution, helps Una and Renly, frees the Hooded One, and ends by defeating Count Geonor; the Seed of Corruption flees east with the Countess.

nodes.name: Act 2 (Vastiri)
nodes.summary: Second PoE2 act, in the Vastiri Desert and Keth. The Exile joins the Ardura Maraketh caravan, recreates the Horn of the Vastiri to dispel Jamanra's sandstorm, pursues the Countess to the Dreadnought, and learns the Hooded One is Sin.

nodes.name: Act 3 (Utzaal)
nodes.summary: Third PoE2 act, in the jungles and drowned city of Utzaal. The Exile lowers the lake, enters the Vaal sites, is sent back in time via a gateway to Utzaal's past, and brings Doryani to the present.

nodes.name: Ogham
nodes.summary: Forest region where the PoE2 campaign opens; Count Geonor rules it from Ogham Manor and the Ezomytes live under his terror.

nodes.name: Clearfell
nodes.summary: Ezomyte logging encampment in Ogham that serves as Act 1's town hub, where Una and Renly operate.

nodes.name: The Grelwood
nodes.summary: Act 1 forest containing the Tree of Souls that binds the Hooded One.

nodes.name: The Red Vale
nodes.summary: Act 1 vale of battle debris where three Obelisks of Rust hold Runes of Power.

nodes.name: The Grim Tangle
nodes.summary: Overgrown sinkholes beneath Ogham leading to the Count's grave past the Memorial Gate.

nodes.name: Hunting Grounds
nodes.summary: Act 1 area beyond the clan graves that Una directs the Exile through toward Ogham Village.

nodes.name: Ogham Manor
nodes.summary: Count Geonor's manor; Count Geonor is the Act 1 act boss (Progression table: area level 15, last area).

nodes.name: Ogham Village
nodes.summary: Act 1 village where the Executioner is found and the Seed of Corruption is sought.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Find the entrance to the Village'

nodes.name: Cemetery of the Eternals
nodes.summary: Act 1 graveyard hosting the Tomb of the Consort and the Mausoleum of the Praetor.

nodes.name: The Ardura Caravan
nodes.summary: Mobile Maraketh caravan and Act 2 town hub, led by Zarka and Sekhema Asala.

nodes.name: The Halani Gates
nodes.summary: Gates to the Maraketh city of Deshar; Jamanra locks them; a sandstorm blocks the road after the first battle at the gates.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Talk to Asala about the closed Gates'

nodes.name: Traitor's Passage
nodes.summary: Hidden tunnel leading to the top of the Halani Gates, where Balbala is sealed as a Djinn.

nodes.name: Mawdun Quarry
nodes.summary: Faridun camp where the Countess had Jamanra's followers prepare weapons and the Dreadnought.

nodes.name: Mawdun Mine
nodes.summary: Abandoned Faridun foundry guarded by Rudja, the Dread Engineer.

nodes.name: Deshar
nodes.summary: Maraketh burial site with the Burial Spires, where the honoured dead are given sky burials.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Use the Desert Map to travel to Deshar'

nodes.name: Path of Mourning
nodes.summary: Route through Deshar that leads the Exile to the Faridun at the Spires.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Travel through the Path of Mourning'

nodes.name: The Dreadnought
nodes.summary: Faridun war caravan carrying the Beast across the Vastiri; the Act 2 boss is fought on it.

nodes.name: Keth
nodes.summary: Buried city where the Water Goddess Halani lies and the Essence of Water is found.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Use the Desert Map to travel to Keth'

nodes.name: The Titan Grotto
nodes.summary: Grotto beneath the Valley of the Titans where Zalmarath guards the Flame Ruby.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Find a way into the Titan Grotto'

nodes.name: The Bone Pits
nodes.summary: Site in the Mastodon Badlands where Ekbab and Iktab guard the Mastodon Tusks.

nodes.name: Buried Shrines
nodes.summary: Shrine area of Keth guarded by Azarian, the Forsaken Son.

nodes.name: Ziggurat Encampment
nodes.summary: Treasure-hunter camp on a ziggurat in the lake of Utzaal; Act 3 hub with Alva, Oswald, and Servi.

nodes.name: Sandswept Marsh
nodes.summary: Marsh crossed in search of the Ziggurat that marks the sunken city.

nodes.name: Infested Barrens
nodes.summary: Area where the stone altar needs a large Soul Core to open the Matlan Waterways.

nodes.name: Chimeral Wetlands
nodes.summary: Wetland crossed on the way to Jiquani's Machinarium, guarded by Xyclucian.

nodes.name: Jiquani's Machinarium
nodes.summary: Unlooted Vaal facility with a stone door that needs a small Soul Core.

nodes.name: Jiquani's Sanctum
nodes.summary: Deep chamber with generators and the large Soul Core, guarded by Zicoatl.

nodes.name: The Matlan Waterways
nodes.summary: Ancient canal system whose control mechanism drains the Utzaal lake.

nodes.name: The Drowned City
nodes.summary: Submerged city section revealed after the lake is drained.

nodes.name: Aggorat
nodes.summary: Vaal structure known as the Apex of Filth, beyond the Drowned City; holds the Queen of Filth and the Black Chambers.

nodes.name: Temple of Kopec
nodes.summary: Temple of the Sun God beneath the treasure-hunter camp, where Ketzuli is defeated and the gateway is found.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Enter the Temple of Kopec'

nodes.name: The Black Chambers
nodes.summary: Chambers in Aggorat where Doryani is found holding Alva.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Find Doryani in the Black Chambers'

nodes.name: Utzaal
nodes.summary: Sunken Vaal city in the jungles of Act 3; the Hooded One sends the Exile to Utzaal to seek knowledge of the Beast. Its past version is reached through a time gateway.

sources.locator: Quest logs 'Speak to the Hooded One' / 'Enter Utzaal in the past'

nodes.name: Sin
nodes.summary: God Sin, 'Thief of Virtue'. In PoE2 Act 2 the Hooded One reveals himself as Sin and as the creator of the Beast.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest'

nodes.name: The Beast
nodes.summary: Ancient divine creature grown from the Seed of Corruption by Sin; in PoE2 a Beast carried across the Vastiri on the Faridun Dreadnought and fed corpses by the Countess's plan.

nodes.name: Halani, the Water Goddess
nodes.summary: Water goddess lying in a shrine at the heart of Keth. She asks the Exile to burn her with Everburning Cinders to end her suffering.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Talk to the Water Goddess' / 'End the Water Goddess' suffering'

nodes.name: Garukhan
nodes.summary: The PoE1 wiki's Orbala page says PoE2 identifies Garukhan as the ascended Orbala (mortal Maraketh warrior); the PoE1 wiki and PoE2 quests do not fully confirm this, so it stays inferred. The Horn of the Vastiri quest retraces Orbala's footsteps.

nodes.name: Twilight Order
nodes.summary: Cult led by the Countess (Oriana) seeking a 'Utopia' free of the gods, plotting a new Beast and Cataclysm.

nodes.name: Maraketh
nodes.summary: Desert people of the Vastiri; the Ardura akhara and the honoured dead of Deshar are Maraketh.

nodes.name: Ardura Akhara
nodes.summary: Maraketh akhara (caravan order) led by Sekhema Asala and Zarka that the Exile joins in Act 2.

nodes.name: Faridun
nodes.summary: Rejected Maraketh outcasts of the Vastiri desert, who ally with the Countess and resurrected Jamanra to feed the Beast.

sources.locator: Overview and Events in Path of Exile 2

nodes.name: Vaal
nodes.summary: Vaal civilisation of Utzaal and its remnants; Alva is a descendant of Vaal survivors.

nodes.name: Count Geonor
nodes.summary: Count of Ogham who imprisoned the Hooded One in the Prelude, about 20 years after Kitava's defeat,, took the Seed of Corruption, and ruled Ogham through terror. Killed by the Exile in Ogham Manor at the end of Act 1.

nodes.name: The Hooded One
nodes.summary: Unnamed Hooded One bound by a runed sword in the Grelwood's Tree of Souls, later revealed as Sin (Thief of Virtue) who created the Beast; guides the Exile through Acts 1-3.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest'

nodes.name: Una
nodes.summary: Ezomyte Clearfell leader who helps the Exile free the Hooded One and sends them to recover Count Lachlann's ring.

sources.locator: Quest 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One'

nodes.name: Renly
nodes.summary: Clearfell blacksmith who rewards the Exile for slaying the Bloated Miller and forges the Rune Spikes from the Red Vale runes.

nodes.name: The Bloated Miller
nodes.summary: Diseased former human who terrorises the logging camp; the Exile's first boss.

nodes.name: The Rust King
nodes.summary: Guardian of the final Rune of Power in the Red Vale.

nodes.name: Lachlann of Endless Lament
nodes.summary: Lachlann the Lost, a Count of the Cemetery of the Eternals seeking to reunite with his family; the Exile puts him to rest after the Memorial Gate opens.

nodes.name: Praetor Draven
nodes.summary: Praetor of the Mausoleum; the Exile destroys him to obtain his Memorial Key piece.

nodes.name: Asinia, the Praetor's Consort
nodes.summary: Draven's consort in the Tomb of the Consort; the Exile destroys her to obtain her Memorial Key piece.

nodes.name: The Executioner
nodes.summary: Ogham executioner who tried to hang the Exile in the opening; killed by the Exile at Ogham Village, freeing Leitis.

nodes.name: Leitis
nodes.summary: Ogham prisoner held by the Executioner; freed by the Exile, and sends the Exile after Count Geonor.

nodes.name: The Countess (Oriana)
nodes.summary: Leader of the Twilight Order and antagonist of PoE2, who took the Seed of Corruption to create a new Beast. Escapes the Exile repeatedly during Acts 1-2; her son Lumerius is named in the wiki.

nodes.name: Jamanra, the Risen King
nodes.summary: Faridun leader resurrected by the Countess, who locks the Halani Gates, summons sandstorms, and is later executed by Sekhema Asala as Jamanra the Abomination.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Risen King' / 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination'

nodes.name: Balbala, the Released
nodes.summary: Former Maraketh traitor sealed as an undying Djinn in Traitor's Passage; released by the Exile and becomes a mentor Djinn.

nodes.name: Zarka
nodes.summary: Ardura Maraketh elder who runs the caravan, recreates the Horn of the Vastiri with the Exile, and gives the Exile the status of jingakh.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Recreate the Horn of the Vastiri'

nodes.name: Sekhema Asala
nodes.summary: Sekhema of the Ardura akhara; leads the Maraketh against the Faridun and executes Jamanra the Abomination.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Consult with Asala' / 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination'

nodes.name: Shambrin
nodes.summary: Maraketh dekhara who asks the Exile to search Deshar for the corpse of a woman she cared about, Lailuma.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Use the Desert Map to travel to Traitor's Passage'

nodes.name: Risu
nodes.summary: Faridun defector freed at Mawdun Quarry who reveals Jamanra's plans, the Halani Gates closure, and Traitor's Passage.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Question the Faridun Defector' / 'Talk to Risu'

nodes.name: Rudja, the Dread Engineer
nodes.summary: Faridun engineer guarding Mawdun Mine's abandoned foundry.

nodes.name: Rathbreaker
nodes.summary: Sun Clan leader of the hyenic raiders harassing the trade route that blocks the Ardura caravan; the Exile's first Act 2 boss.

nodes.name: Azarian, the Forsaken Son
nodes.summary: Unique guardian of the Buried Shrines of Keth, defeated to reach the Essence of Water.

nodes.name: Ekbab, Ancient Steed
nodes.summary: Guardian of the Mastodon Tusks in the Bone Pits, assisted by Iktab; defeated to obtain the Tusks for Zarka.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab'

nodes.name: Iktab, the Deathlord
nodes.summary: Undead lord assisting Ekbab in the Bone Pits.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab'

nodes.name: Zalmarath, the Colossus
nodes.summary: Colossus guarding the Titan Grotto; holds the Flame Ruby for the Rite of Flame.

nodes.name: Tor Gul, the Defiler
nodes.summary: Faridun boss of the Spires of Deshar, defeated before the Dreadnought assault.

sources.locator: Progression table, The Spires of Deshar

nodes.name: Viper Napuatzi
nodes.summary: Vaal general of Utzaal's past who captures Alva and sends her to Doryani; defeated in the Utzaal time-gate sequence.

nodes.name: Alva Valai
nodes.summary: Vaal-descended treasure hunter who guides the Exile through Utzaal, activates the time gateway and is rescued from Doryani.

nodes.name: Oswald
nodes.summary: Treasure-hunter Quartermaster of the Ziggurat Encampment who buys salvage and shipping for Kingsmarch.

nodes.name: Servi
nodes.summary: Tribal guide who warns the Exile of a forsaken ruin in the dark where Soul Cores may be found; the Azmeri-descent and Azak/Orok politics claims are not supported by the corpus and were removed.

nodes.name: Xyclucian, the Chimera
nodes.summary: Unique chimera guarding the entrance to Jiquani's Machinarium; drops the Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum.

nodes.name: Zicoatl, Warden of the Core
nodes.summary: Warden guarding the large Soul Core in Jiquani's Sanctum.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Zicoatl, Warden of the Core'

nodes.name: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun
nodes.summary: Vaal high priest of the Sun God in the Temple of Kopec whose research leads to the time gateway.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun'

nodes.name: The Queen of Filth
nodes.summary: Boss of Aggorat (Apex of Filth) who drops the Temple Door Idol needed for the Temple of Kopec.

nodes.name: Doryani
nodes.summary: Vaal Royal Thaumaturgist to Queen Atziri (PoE1 wiki: Queen's Thaumaturgist); in PoE2 he is captured in Utzaal's past, agrees to help contain the Beast, and joins the present-day effort with a weapon fragment.

sources.locator: Quest logs 'Capture Doryani' / 'Speak to Doryani in Ziggurat Encampment'

nodes.name: Atziri
nodes.summary: Queen of the Vaal, whose planned communion with the Beast in Utzaal's past led to the Vaal Cataclysm.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Capture Doryani' (quote 'Atziri will soon commune with the Beast')

nodes.name: Exile sentenced to hang in Ogham
nodes.summary: Count Geonor sentences the Exile to death; the Executioner tries to hang them, and the Exile escapes by jumping into the ocean.

nodes.name: Slay the Bloated Miller
nodes.summary: The Exile follows a wounded man's warning to Clearfell, kills the Bloated Miller, and receives a reward from Renly (the quest is on The Riverbank; the Miller attacks the camp).

nodes.name: Release the Hooded One from the Tree of Souls
nodes.summary: In the Grelwood the Exile finds the Tree of Souls holding the Hooded One; Una says only runes can break the binding, so the Exile collects Runes of Power from the Red Vale and stabs them into the Tree with the forged Rune Spikes.

sources.locator: Quest 'Use the Rune Spikes' / 'Speak to Una'

nodes.name: Revive the Hooded One with Count Lachlann's ring
nodes.summary: Through the Grim Tangle, the Exile brings Count Lachlann's ring to Una, who revives the Hooded One; he reveals the Seed of Corruption is in Ogham and must be recovered.

sources.locator: Quest 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One'

nodes.name: Open the Memorial Gate for Lachlann
nodes.summary: In the Cemetery of the Eternals the Exile destroys Asinia and Praetor Draven for the two Memorial Key pieces, opens the gate, and puts Lachlann to rest.

nodes.name: Kill the Executioner and free Leitis
nodes.summary: The Exile finds the Executioner at Ogham Village, frees his prisoner Leitis, and Leitis (who says 'He killed Eamon') then asks the Exile to depose Count Geonor.

nodes.name: Slay Count Geonor in Ogham Manor
nodes.summary: The Exile infiltrates Ogham Manor and kills Count Geonor, freeing Ogham; Oriana escapes with the Beast, and the Hooded One sends the Exile east toward the Vastiri.

sources.locator: Quest 'Kill the Mad Wolf' / 'Return to Town'

nodes.name: Earn passage on the Ardura caravan
nodes.summary: The Exile defeats the Sun Clan hyenas and their leader Rathbreaker for Zarka, who admits the Exile to the Ardura akhara as a jingakh.

nodes.name: Rudja and the Faridun defector at Mawdun Mine
nodes.summary: At Mawdun Quarry and Mine, the Exile defeats Rudja and frees the defector Risu, who reveals Jamanra's plan to feed the Beast and that the Halani Gates are closed.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Rudja, Dread Engineer' / 'Talk to Risu about the closed Gates'

nodes.name: Release Balbala in Traitor's Passage
nodes.summary: Using Risu's passage, the Exile climbs Traitor's Passage and defeats Balbala, releasing the sealed Djinn.

nodes.name: First battle at the Halani Gates
nodes.summary: The Exile opens the gates with Asala; Jamanra, the Risen King, is fought at the gates and retreats behind an impassable sandstorm (Faridun page), while the Countess escapes.

sources.locator: Quest 'Open the third Gate' / 'Return to the Ardura Caravan'

nodes.name: Keth: the Essence of Water
nodes.summary: Following the sand-buried city of Keth, the Exile defeats Azarian, the Forsaken Son, and burns the Water Goddess Halani at her request to recover the Essence of Water.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat Azarian' / 'End the Water Goddess' suffering'

nodes.name: Mastodon Tusks from the Bone Pits
nodes.summary: In the Bone Pits the Exile defeats Ekbab and Iktab for the Mastodon Tusks that Jamanra wanted for lightning powers.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Defeat Ekbab, Ancient Steed and Iktab'

nodes.name: Flame Ruby from the Titan Grotto
nodes.summary: Through the Titan Grotto's Rite of Flame, the Exile defeats Zalmarath, the Colossus, and recovers the Flame Ruby for Zarka.

nodes.name: Recreate the Horn of the Vastiri
nodes.summary: With Zarka, the Exile reforges the Horn of the Vastiri from the three sub-quest items to counter Jamanra's sandstorm, retracing Orbala's footsteps.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Recreate the Horn of the Vastiri'

nodes.name: Dispel the sandstorm with the Horn of the Vastiri
nodes.summary: The Exile sounds the Horn of the Vastiri at the sandstorm, dispelling Jamanra's barrier, and Asala then turns the caravan toward Deshar.

sources.locator: Quest 'Use the Horn of the Vastiri' / 'Speak to Asala'

nodes.name: Defeat Tor Gul in the Spires of Deshar
nodes.summary: In Deshar the Exile climbs the Path of Mourning to the Spires, where the Faridun have taken the honoured dead, and defeats Tor Gul, the Defiler.

nodes.name: Board the Dreadnought and defeat Jamanra, the Abomination
nodes.summary: The Exile boards the Dreadnought; Jamanra the Abomination fights, the Countess escapes, and Asala beheads Jamanra. The Beast escapes with the Countess once more.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination' / 'Speak to Asala'

nodes.name: The Hooded One reveals he is Sin
nodes.summary: At a shrine northwest of the caravan, the Hooded One confesses he is Sin, the Thief of Virtue, and that he created the Beast; he sends the Exile south into the long-ago Vaal jungles to find a way to drain the Beast.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest' (quote 'I am... a god. I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin.')
[77:11] 'I am the thief of virtue.' / [77:14] 'I am sin.' (Gavryn, Act 2 full dialogue, auto-captions)

nodes.name: Arrive at the Ziggurat Encampment in Utzaal
nodes.summary: The Hooded One sends the Exile to Utzaal; the Exile crosses the Sandswept Marsh to the Ziggurat, meeting Oswald and Alva.

nodes.name: Defeat Xyclucian and enter the Machinarium
nodes.summary: In the Chimeral Wetlands the Exile defeats Xyclucian, the Chimera, and enters Jiquani's Machinarium, where Alva sends them after a small Soul Core.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Xyclucian, the Chimera' / 'Enter Jiquani's Machinarium'

nodes.name: Defeat Zicoatl and take the large Soul Core
nodes.summary: Inside Jiquani's Sanctum the Exile powers two generators with medium Soul Cores and defeats Zicoatl, Warden of the Core, to take the large Soul Core.

sources.locator: Quest 'Activate two Generators' / 'Defeat Zicoatl, Warden of the Core'

nodes.name: Drain the lake through the Matlan Waterways
nodes.summary: The Exile powers the Infested Barrens altar with the large Soul Core and activates the Matlan Waterways, revealing the Sunken City of Utzaal.

sources.locator: Quest 'Activate The Matlan Waterways' / 'Talk to Alva'

nodes.name: The Temple Door Idol from the Queen of Filth
nodes.summary: The Exile enters the Drowned City and Aggorat, defeats the Queen of Filth, and takes the Temple Door Idol to open the Temple of Kopec.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat the Queen of Filth' / 'Pick up the Temple Door Idol'

nodes.name: Defeat Ketzuli in the Temple of Kopec
nodes.summary: In the Temple of Kopec the Exile defeats Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun, and Alva activates an elevator and gateway into the Ziggurat's past.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun' / 'Ride the Elevator'

nodes.name: Enter the time gateway to Utzaal's past
nodes.summary: The gateway sends the Exile and Alva into Utzaal's past, where the Vaal see Alva and the Exile as threats while the Cataclysm is imminent.

sources.locator: Quest 'Enter the Time Portal' / 'Enter Utzaal in the past'

nodes.name: Defeat Viper Napuatzi in Utzaal's past
nodes.summary: In Utzaal's past the Vaal general Viper Napuatzi has Alva taken to Doryani; the Exile defeats Napuatzi to open the path.

nodes.name: Capture Doryani in the Black Chambers
nodes.summary: The Exile fights through Aggorat to the Black Chambers, rescues Alva, and captures Doryani, who agrees to help contain the Beast with a piece of the Precursor weapon.

sources.locator: Quest 'Capture Doryani for his knowledge of the Beast'

nodes.name: Survive the Utzaal Cataclysm through the gateway
nodes.summary: The Exile and Alva survive the Cataclysm in Utzaal's past and return through the gateway with Doryani, who then laments that his people are long dead.

nodes.name: Doryani joins the Exile and the Hooded One in the present
nodes.summary: In the present Doryani confirms he holds one piece of an ancient anti-Corruption weapon; Alva proposes Kingsmarch as a base, and the Hooded One decides the group should travel south to Ngamakanui to find the other pieces.

nodes.name: Seed of Corruption
nodes.summary: Metallic sphere holding the Seed of Corruption, which Count Geonor took from the Hooded One; it feeds the Beast's growth.

nodes.name: Count Lachlann's Ring
nodes.summary: Signet ring of Count Lachlann bearing his rune of Authority, needed by Una to heal the Hooded One's runic wound.

sources.locator: Quest 'Bring Count Lachlann's Ring to Una'

nodes.name: Horn of the Vastiri
nodes.summary: Ancient horn that controls the winds; recreated from three items and sounded to dispel Jamanra's sandstorm.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Recreate the Horn of the Vastiri' / 'Use the Horn of the Vastiri'

nodes.name: The Essence of Water
nodes.summary: Quest item from the Buried Shrines of Keth, one of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri.

sources.locator: Quest 'Pick up the Essence of Water'

nodes.name: The Flame Ruby
nodes.summary: Quest item dropped by Zalmarath in the Titan Grotto; one of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri.

nodes.name: Mastodon Tusks
nodes.summary: Tusks from the Bone Pits that Jamanra sought for lightning abilities; one of the three components of the Horn of the Vastiri.

nodes.name: Balbala's Barya
nodes.summary: Djinn barya holding Balbala's soul; placed in the Relic Altar at the Trial of the Sekhemas so that she can serve as a mentor Djinn.

sources.locator: Quest 'Place your Barya into the Relic Altar'

nodes.name: Precursor Weapon (Weapon in pieces)
nodes.summary: Ancient anti-Corruption weapon of a lost civilisation, in pieces: Doryani holds one, the others are scattered in Ngamakanui.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Doryani in Ziggurat Encampment' / Hooded One follow-up

nodes.name: Large Soul Core
nodes.summary: Charged soul core powering the Matlan Waterways mechanism that drains the Utzaal lake.

sources.locator: Quest 'Retrieve the Large Soul Core' / 'Enter The Matlan Waterways'

nodes.name: Temple Door Idol
nodes.summary: Idol dropped by the Queen of Filth that opens the Temple of Kopec door.

sources.locator: Quest 'Pick up the Temple Door Idol'

nodes.name: The Riverbank
nodes.summary: Act 1 starting area where the Exile washes up after escaping execution; the Bloated Miller is the area boss and the Reaching Clearfell quest starts here.

sources.locator: Act 1 intro and Progression table (The Riverbank, boss: The Bloated Miller)
quest 'Reaching Clearfell' is a quest in the act 1 area The Riverbank

The Exile slays Count Geonor in Ogham Manor, ending his rule over Ogham.
The Exile kills the Bloated Miller, who attacked Clearfell's logging camp.
The Exile destroys the Rust King to take the final Rune of Power.
The Exile uses the Rune Spikes to release the Hooded One from the Tree of Souls.

sources.locator: Walkthrough 'Stab the Rune Spikes into the Tree of Souls'

edges.description: The Exile destroys Asinia to obtain her Memorial Key piece.
The Exile destroys Praetor Draven to obtain his Memorial Key piece.
The Exile opens the Memorial Gate and puts Lachlann to rest, releasing him from his endless lament.
The Exile kills the Executioner at Ogham Village.
The Exile frees Leitis from the Executioner's prison.
The Exile defeats Rathbreaker and the Sun Clan hyenas raiding the Maraketh route.
The Exile defeats Rudja, the Dread Engineer of Mawdun Mine.
The Exile rescues the Faridun defector Risu at Mawdun Quarry.

sources.locator: Events in Path of Exile 2 (Risu was freed in the Quarry)

edges.description: The Exile defeats Balbala in Traitor's Passage, releasing her from her sealed Djinn prison.
The Exile defeats Azarian, the Forsaken Son, in the Buried Shrines.
At Halani's request the Exile burns her with Everburning Cinders, ending her suffering.
The Exile defeats Ekbab, Ancient Steed, to take the Mastodon Tusks.

The Exile sounds the recreated Horn of the Vastiri to dispel Jamanra's sandstorm.

The Exile defeats Xyclucian, the Chimera, to enter Jiquani's Machinarium.
The Exile defeats Zicoatl, Warden of the Core, to obtain the large Soul Core.

sources.locator: Quest 'Defeat Zicoatl, Warden of the Core'

The Exile rescues Alva from Doryani in the Black Chambers.

sources.locator: Quest 'Rescue Alva' / 'Find Doryani in the Black Chambers'

sources.locator: Quest 'Capture Doryani for his knowledge of the Beast'

edges.description: After capture Doryani agrees to help contain the Beast; the Hooded One says their goals are aligned.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to Alva' / Hooded One follow-up

edges.description: The Countess escapes the Exile at the Halani Gates and again on the Dreadnought; the quest log quotes her taunt ('You again!... the fool under the Hooded One's sway') in the Dreadnought fight.

sources.locator: Quest 'Fight your way to the Throne' (quote 'You again!...')

edges.description: The Countess (Oriana) is the leader of the Twilight Order.
Oriana colluded with Count Geonor and Jamanra, enticing them to use the Beast and abandoning them when no longer useful.
Oriana promised and then carried out the resurrection of the Faridun revolutionary Jamanra with corruption.
Oriana gathered the Faridun at Mawdun Quarry to prepare the Dreadnought.
Jamanra is the revolutionary leader of the Faridun, resurrected to lead them against the Maraketh.
Sekhema Asala beheads Jamanra the Abomination after the Exile fights him on the Dreadnought.
The Exile fights Jamanra on the Dreadnought.
Sekhema Asala leads the Ardura akhara.
Zarka is an elder of the Ardura akhara who runs the caravan.
Risu is a Faridun defector.
In Act 2 the Hooded One confesses: 'I am... a god. I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin.'

sources.locator: Quest log 'Speak to the Hooded One in the Shrine to the Northwest' (quote)

edges.description: Sin created the Beast from the Seed of Corruption, and in PoE2 the Hooded One confesses he created the Beast.
In the Prelude, about 20 years after Kitava's defeat, Geonor impaled and bound the Hooded One with a runed sword and took the Seed of Corruption.
Geonor took the Seed of Corruption from the Hooded One and carried it away.
The Hooded One wants the Seed put back into containment, and the Exile is sent to find it.

sources.locator: Quest 'Witness the revival of the Hooded One'

edges.description: Una directs the Exile through the Grim Tangle and sends them to the Count's grave for the ring.

sources.locator: Quest 'Speak to Una about the roots'

edges.description: Renly forges the Rune Spikes and sends the Exile to the Grelwood.
Zarka admits the Exile to the Ardura akhara as a jingakh and gives direction on the Horn.
Asala directs the Exile through the Halani Gates and Deshar and recruits them to the Maraketh cause.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Talk to Asala about Risu's information'

edges.description: Servi tells the Exile about Soul Cores and the Infested Barrens ruin.
Alva leads the Exile through Utzaal's Machinarium and activates the time gateway.
Oswald is Quartermaster of the Ziggurat Encampment: he buys salvage and ships it to Kingsmarch (not a quest-giving mentor).
Doryani pleaded with Atziri for patience, but she would not abide him; he worked to stop her communion with the Beast (PoE1 wiki: "worked tirelessly to try to stop Atziri").

sources.locator: Quest log 'Capture Doryani' (quote 'I pleaded with Atziri for her patience... but she would not abide me')

edges.description: Atziri planned a communion with the Beast in Utzaal's past, causing the Vaal Cataclysm.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Capture Doryani' (quote 'Atziri will soon commune with the Beast')

edges.description: Napuatzi has Alva taken to Doryani for being of Vaal blood.

sources.locator: Quest log 'Explore Utzaal in the past'

edges.description: Viper Napuatzi is the Vaal general.
Alva is of Vaal blood, a descendant of the Vaal survivors.
Ketzuli is the high priest of the Temple of Kopec.
Doryani holds one piece of the Precursor weapon and the rest are scattered in the Karui archipelago.
Doryani was the thaumaturge whose experiments led to the Cataclysm.
PoE2 Act 3 shows the Vaal Cataclysm from inside Utzaal's past, via the time gateway, reframing it as Atziri's communion rather than Doryani's alone.
The Exile is brought into the Maraketh's Ardura akhara as a jingakh.
Zarka is a Maraketh caravan elder.
The Exile travels to Utzaal to find knowledge of the Beast's containment.
The Hooded One calls Doryani the foremost expert on the Beast and works with him, though he doubts his trustworthiness.
